points.title: Model the data
points.ask: Define each account's data, how it is collected, cleaned and unified across divisions; state assumptions.

evidence.label: Account data carried
evidence.value: purchases · installed base · interactions · signals · credit

evidence.label: Cleaning rules
evidence.value: GSTIN mod-36 check · PAN rescue · fuzzy name within city

points.how: Entity resolution: exact GSTIN → PAN (chars 3–12) → rapidfuzz token-set ≥ 0.88 within the same city; ground truth is kept in the synthetic world so precision/recall are measured, not claimed.
gaps: Division ERPs are simulated; production needs read-only ERP/CRM extracts (field map in DATA_SOURCES.md).

points.title: Detect the opportunity
points.ask: Identify what each account needs next, from single products to full solutions; justify the technique and measure accuracy.

evidence.label: Precision@5
evidence.note: popularity 0.1817 — value ranking is the edge

evidence.label: Model versions (champion/challenger)
evidence.note: retrains on new orders, feedback and nightly

points.how: Calibrated gradient-boosted trees over 24 explainable features (co-purchase lift, peer adoption, solution coverage, intent in notes, seasonality, credit headroom), ranked by probability × margin × cash velocity.
gaps: On raw hit-rate (precision@5) the model ties the popularity baseline — its edge is ranking by value (GP capture).
Solution-level labels are sparse; solution scores combine component probabilities.

points.title: Capture and route to action
points.ask: Record each opportunity, send it to the right division/salesperson with ownership and tracking to revenue; handle overlaps and escalation.

evidence.label: Routed to an owner
evidence.note: median 3.0 min from signal to owner

evidence.label: Overlaps resolved by split credit
evidence.note: one lead (70%) + assists (30%); cross-sell folded into solutions

points.how: Owner-first routing (account owner in the lead division) → capacity overflow to the least-loaded rep in region → national → service desks. SLA ladder: L1 nudge 48 h · L2 reassign 72 h · L3 head · L4 nurture.
gaps: WhatsApp/email delivery is an outbox simulation; production uses the WhatsApp Business API.

points.title: Build a working prototype
points.ask: Show end to end what a salesperson and a sales head see and do; fit existing workflows and scale without headcount.

evidence.label: Roles with their own workspace
evidence.note: rep · KAM · head · architect · data steward · partner

evidence.label: Fits existing workflow
evidence.value: WhatsApp brief · one-tap accept · voice copilot · ERP order ingest
evidence.note: no new data-entry screens for reps

points.how: Signal → scored opportunity → routed owner → WhatsApp brief → accept → proposal link → PO → attribution → retrain. Every step is visible in the opportunity timeline.
gaps: Rep and head workflows tested by the team only; month-2 adoption gate validates with real reps.

points.title: Prove it works
points.ask: 6-month pilot metrics for cross-sell, solution and recurring revenue; attribution; scale/stop rules; risks.

evidence.label: Decision rule today
evidence.note: Gross-profit uplift is positive at 90% confidence and annuity grows ≥25% — roll out to all branches.

evidence.label: Rep feedback captured
evidence.note: 'not relevant' rate is a month-3 gate

points.how: Monte Carlo over the real opportunity book with common random numbers; counterfactual calibrated on the control group's observed conversion. Gates at months 2/3/4/6; stop rule keeps the data layer.
gaps: Annuity is 1.1% of revenue today, so ARR uplift starts from a very small base.
Only 1 rep ratings so far; feedback priors stay near neutral until ~50 per category.

criteria.evidence: AUC 0.8257 on a 120-day time split; ECE 0.0152; runs on CPU; retrain ≈ 20 s
5 division silos unified; 36 categories; OSM + NASA/ESA open imagery; investor filings for calibration
Reason codes on every score; 1794/1794 opportunities carry a written why; 'how calculated' on every screen
DPDP consent + erasure (0 handled); GSTIN validation; PII masking by role; 105 audit rows
66% of workflow automated; 36 open opps per rep; SQLite → Postgres; stateless API
One inbox per role, voice copilot, territory & site twins, a printable 1-page meeting brief
